detail: Anticipated ratings A1 (Moody's) / A (S&P) on the August 2026 senior notes; investment grade with wide headroom.

Record $4.75B senior unsecured offering closed Aug 17, 2026: $1.25B 4.60% 2029 (YTM 4.64%, T+43bp), $1.5B 5.00% 2031, $1.0B 5.25% 2033, $1.0B 5.50% 2036 (YTM 5.53%); 'general corporate purposes'. Total debt more than doubled to $7.1B.

Goldman Sachs: AMD 5-yr CDS widened 26.5bp in one week to ~147bp, ~55bp off its low two months earlier; chipmaker CDS basket (AVGO, AMD, NVDA, INTC) now above hyperscalers for first time, attributed to customer financing/guarantees.
Barclays: AMD 5-yr CDS up ~177% in six months from ~40bp area; recommends viewing chip suppliers as 'lenders with concentrated loan books'.
Up to 320M shares owed to OpenAI and Meta under performance warrants; Anthropic placement and acquisitions (World Labs ~$8.2B all-stock; Taalas ~$2.9B cash+stock) use stock.
AA (S&P Global Ratings) cited at March 2026 bond sale.
A1 senior unsecured affirmed, outlook stable, despite $200B 2026 capex plan (reports conflict: one outlet says Baa1/Aa -- treat agency letter with medium confidence).
~$37B US (11 tranches, ~$126B orders) + EUR14.5B (~$16.8B) debut euro deal; ~$54B total; new-issue concession ~10-12bp.
'Surprise' $25B, 8 tranches (3-40yr); 18-21bp new-issue concession on long bonds; book only 2.5x (vs 3.2x in March); hyperscaler spreads widened 6-15bp that day. 2026 borrowing ~ $92B.
First sterling bonds (4 tranches, 3-19yr), guidance +70 to +110bp over gilts; also record CHF and CAD deals earlier in 2026; 2026 programme >$92B equivalent.
Oct 2026: new $5.0B 364-day revolver and new $15.0B unsecured revolving credit facility replaced prior agreements.
AI spending 'threatens credit quality' of hyperscalers incl. Amazon; Moody's treats >$820B of unstarted leases across group as debt-equivalent; no imminent downgrade.
No reported CDS level found.

A- affirmed; outlook cut to Stable from Positive on Oct 29, 2026, citing counterparty/customer concentration and 'growing off-balance-sheet financings' (residual value support) that could magnify downside; would downgrade if off-balance financings exceed base case.

A3 senior unsecured (upgraded Sept 2025, positive outlook). Per Reuters (Oct 26), Moody's called Broadcom one of the strongest large tech credits but said risk would rise with several such deals in a short time; no rating action.

5-yr CDS closed at a record ~175.4bp on Oct 29, 2026 (Bloomberg data); Goldman put it at ~186bp in early Nov, ~70bp wider than two months earlier. Barclays: AVGO 5-yr CDS +258% in six months and recommended buying AVGO protection as a hedge for AI financing stress.
Repaid $5.6B of long-term debt in FQ3 and $1.5B of senior notes after quarter end; ~$59.6B fixed-rate debt at ~4% average coupon.
~$21-22B of North Star senior debt (Broadcom-backed) expected to be refinanced in the IG bond market in early 2027, adding to perceived Broadcom-linked supply.

Moody's Ba3 corporate family, B1 senior unsecured (stable), affirmed 2026-10-20. S&P B+ issuer; B on 9.625% 2032 notes. Fitch issuer BB- (positive outlook, July 2026). Contract-backed DDTL 4.0 rated A3 (Moody's) / A(low) DBRS; DDTL 5.0/5.5 Ba2 / BB+.
5-year CDS rose as much as 76bp to 1,232.6bp on Nov 20 (implies >65% 5-yr default probability); Deutsche Bank data showed >1,289bp on Nov 19; ~1,140bp after the midterms.

Unsecured notes (coupons 8.5-9.75%) trading ~80 cents: 9.75% 2031 at 79.75 (15.83% yield) on Nov 2; 9.625% 2032 yield >16% on Nov 6, 14.21% on Nov 11. CEO: will not use unsecured market at current yields.

$4.2B 2.875% convertible senior notes due 2033 closed Sept 22, 2026 (conversion ~$97.85). DDTL 5.5 $2.6B at SOFR+5.50% (Aug 2026, $1.56B drawn). Seeking >= $4B investment-grade loan backed by Meta contracts via Morgan Stanley/MUFG at ~7-7.5% (Nov 2026, not closed).
ATM program for up to 35M Class A shares (with collared forwards) set up Sept 17, 2026.
Q3 net interest expense $846M (4x GAAP operating income of $207M); Q4 guided $1.05-1.15B.
Aa2, stable; assigned Aa2 to new senior unsecured notes on 2026-11-02 and 2026-11-12. In June 2026 Moody's called the $84.75B equity raise credit positive.
AA+, stable (affirmed on proposed notes; reiterated in Nov 2026 Canadian bond filing).

Q3 issuance net proceeds $28.7B: $23.8B USD fixed + $1.3B USD floating (WAC 5.55%, WAM 15 yrs) and A$5.6B AUD notes (WAC 5.82%). 2026 YTD: $45.0B USD + $35.8B foreign-currency senior notes; face debt rose from $49.1B to $127.5B.
C$6.0B in 3/8/12/40-yr tranches; 40-yr at 6.000% coupon. Spreads materially wider than May deal (12-yr +145bp vs 10-yr +75bp in May; 40-yr +185bp vs 30-yr +110bp).
$40B ATM program (June 2026): $12.4B sold in Q3 (12M Class A + 24M Class C shares). Plus ~$49.5B stock sale in June; Moody's referenced an $84.75B combined equity raise announcement on June 2.
Alphabet 2.25% 2060 bond quoted at ~6.14% yield (retail quote, date unverified).
Aa3 senior unsecured, stable; assigned to Nov 2026 notes, expecting conservative financial policy and positive net cash.
AA-, outlook revised to NEGATIVE (late Oct 2026). S&P projects FOCF deficits of ~$22B/$71B/$39B for 2026-2028 and leverage of 1.1x (2027) and 1.3x (2028), above its 1.0x downgrade threshold.
~EUR8.25-9B six-tranche debut euro deal (4.30%-6.40% coupons, to 2065); Meta paid ~1.4x Alphabet's euro spreads.
$25.0B fixed-rate senior notes in six series maturing 2031-2066, 4.55%-6.45%.
Beignet Investor ~$27.3B bonds priced ~140bp over Meta's own curve; reports the bonds hit record low price in Sept 2026.
AAA (S&P) / Aaa (Moody's); one of only two US public companies with top ratings from both.
Priced $25B, 10-tranche senior unsecured notes (2- to 40-year) on 2026-10-29 -- first US IG bond since 2017 ($17B). Peak orders ~$115B (4.6x). Note: priced late Oct 2026 (settled around early Nov).
2066 notes at +105bp over Treasuries; 30-year at +95bp; long AAA paper yielding above 6%. One tranche carried a 6.150% coupon (per FourWeekMBA).
CreditSights estimated deal lifts gross lease-adjusted leverage to ~0.7x. CFO: will 'access additional sources of funding when we believe it is attractive'.

Moody's: 'unprecedented' AI spending threatens credit quality of six hyperscalers incl. Microsoft; group lease commitments ~$1.2T, >$820B not yet commenced, treated as debt-equivalent. No imminent downgrade expected.
No reported CDS level found.
No public S&P/Moody's corporate rating found; capital structure is almost entirely convertible notes plus secured contract-backed loans.
Explored a $3-4B five-year high-yield bond (Goldman) in September, balked at costs, dropped it in October.
August 2026 convertibles (issued with 4.5% coupon tranche) fell to ~70 cents on the dollar, yields >12%.
$4.34B converts (March 2026) and $5.75B converts (Aug 24, 2026: 0.50% due 2030 and 4.50% due 2034); ~$10.09B gross in 9M 2026.
$775M term loan (Jul 2026, SOFR+2.50%) secured on an investment-grade customer contract; $3.5B Citi 364-day bridge (Oct 2026, SOFR+2.75% stepping up).
ATM program: ~$2.8B at ~$224/share through Q2; ~$3.9B net treasury share sales in 9M 2026.

Aa1 senior unsecured affirmed; outlook cut to stable from positive on 2026-11-18 citing governance uncertainty after Huang's exit and no formal succession plan; upgrade unlikely for 12-18 months. Moody's says cash should exceed $240B by end FY2028, ample to absorb $118B of guarantees.
Upgraded to AA from AA-, outlook stable; S&P flagged 'AI infrastructure customers' growing dependence on capital markets' as a risk.
$25B senior unsecured notes in seven tranches (2028-2056), coupons 4.25%-5.625%, ~20-65bp over Treasuries, ~$85B orders; first issuance since 2021.
Five-year CDS reported at ~121bp on 2026-11-18, ~20bp tighter than a week earlier (secondary source citing Bloomberg; unverified).
Repaid $1.0B notes in Q3; returned record $28.1B ($22.1B buybacks + $6.0B dividends); $227.3B buyback authorization remaining.

S&P BBB- (stable), cut from BBB on 2026-07-09 (one notch above junk). S&P says it could cut again if adjusted leverage stays >4.5x (S&P sees peak ~4.4x incl. leases) or positive FOCF by FY2029 looks out of reach.

Moody's Baa2, negative outlook, affirmed 2026-11-02; cites OpenAI counterparty risk, uncertain equity funding beyond 2026; adjusted debt/EBITDA >4x at Aug 31; trailing FCF about -$35B (Moody's basis). Fitch BBB, stable, affirmed same day.
5-year CDS ~292bp on Nov 2; record wides on Nov 17; up to 327.9bp on Nov 20 (highest since Oct 20). Was below ~80bp a year earlier.

$10B senior notes priced Nov 2 (closed Nov 4): 7.000% 2029, 7.450% 2031, 7.850% 2033, 8.000% 2037, 8.650% 2046; spreads +240 to +335bp over Treasuries. Existing 4.95% 2031 bond yielded ~7.28% (CNBC), 'more in line with a high-end junk rating' per S&P Global Market Intelligence.

$10B common stock: 86.2M shares at $116 (~11% discount), closed Nov 4. Follows $20B ATM equity completed in Q1 FY27 (141M shares, $19.9B net). Stock closed $101.19 on Nov 20, 12.8% below the offering price.

Investor Day: additional capital-markets funding for FY27-FY30 capped at $20B ($10B equity/$10B gross debt, excl. refinancing) - fully used within a week. Remaining needs met by vendor financing, customer hardware, prepayments.
